messages:
deploy-bot: tag v2.7.1 created by kevin from main (commit abc1234).
Brief changelog:
- fix: reduce KV cache contention under burst
- perf: improved batching heuristics for short prompts
- ops: add runtime pin toggle for quantized models
Release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/v2.7.1

maria: 👍 nice. planning a short canary to staging for 15m. Can someone pin dedicated pools to runtime 1.9.0 for this rollout?

kevin: pinned runtime=1.9.0 in team-dedicated at 09:30 UTC. also set FEATURE_CACHE_PREFETCH=true on staging.

sam: starting smoke tests on staging now — running quick prompts + perf checks. watching p50/p90 and error rates.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started — env=staging, tag=v2.7.1, job=canary-deploy-42, hosts=staging-01..04

alisa: quick heads up — includes DB migration db:schema:v12. It's backward compatible but adds an index; plan to run during change window, low risk.

maria: OK. hold full prod rollout until canary + smoke pass for 30m. Rollback plan if smoke fails: deploy v2.7.0 and open incident channel.

sam: smoke results so far: 15/15 smoke checks passed, p90 latency ~330ms (baseline 320ms), no new errors observed.

deploy-bot: canary succeeded. scheduling prod rollout in 30m at 10:05 UTC. Prod rollout plan: phased 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation steps. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback v2.7.0 --target prod`.

deploy-bot: release assets uploaded — docker gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.7.1, changelog artifact attached.

kevin: I'll be on the 10:05 window to watch metrics and logs. tagging maria for final GO.

maria: GO for prod at +30. I'll pin version and keep cache prefetch on during ramp. If anything odd, we'll abort and rollback. :thumbsup:
